prospect_company_size: eight people and about twenty retainer clients
annual_tool_budget: about 2,500 dollars for a project like this, but only say it if asked directly
pain_points: her account managers lose every Monday pulling numbers from Google Ads, Meta and GA4 into weekly client reports, reports go out late, and two clients complained this quarter
product: a custom AI automation that pulls every client's numbers each week, writes the summary in the agency's voice, and drops a ready-to-send report in Slack for a quick review. A one-time 2,000 dollar build
objections: first, we already pay for ChatGPT, so why would I pay you; second, we paid a freelancer for automations last year and they broke within a month; third, my business partner Marcus handles the budget, so I can't say yes alone
close_criteria: the rep puts a number on the hours lost every Monday, explains specifically why this is more than a ChatGPT subscription, addresses what happens when something breaks (who fixes it, support or handover), and proposes a concrete next step that includes Marcus
